applicableAreas: Valley View Road frontage, Street Yard (H.2) planting zone
findings.comment: Water utility line shown crossing through H.2 Street Yard planting zone along Valley View Road where street trees are present. However, no root barrier boundaries or designated planting zone delineations are marked on landscape plan, and utility type (Austin Water vs. private service) is not specified. Planting zone design cannot be verified from available documents.

Two critical recorded easements required by law are not depicted on site plan: Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE no-build zone) and City of Austin Drainage Easement (2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner). Additionally, transformer pads lack required AE easement documentation: Pads 1 & 3 show only 'Vault Easement' (not AE easement); Pads 2 & 4 have no easement notation. No dedicated AE easements visible encumbering transformer locations.

applicableAreas: Valley View Road public right-of-way, utility service connections
findings.comment: Existing public water and wastewater utilities in Valley View Road ROW are identified for demolition/removal. New private utility service connections are proposed. Site plan does not clearly show whether new private utilities are routed through public ROW or relocated to private property or dedicated easements. Final routing and ROW status cannot be determined from available plans.

Demolition plan shows existing public water and wastewater infrastructure in Valley View Road ROW requiring removal. However, specific method of termination at property line/ROW boundary (capping, plugging, complete removal, or abandonment procedures) is not documented. Demolition notes address private utility abandonment but do not specify how public utilities will be terminated per applicable standards.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary, overhead electric line
findings.comment: Demolition plan notes require coordination with City of Austin for removal of power poles and electric lines. Existing overhead electric line shown on southern property boundary. However, no Austin Energy coordination letters, permits, relocation feasibility studies, or removal approvals are provided in available submittal. Power pole relocation coordination and compliance with clearance/access requirements cannot be verified.
